summary: Backend-only test of Real Enforcement Wave 2 (read-only GETs: attendance, reports, teaching-load, enrollments, alumni, faculty-board, archives, certificates, statements). New pytest suite of 64 tests: 62 passed, 2 failed. Both failures are scope escalation leaks for real-enforcement users. For a user scoped to one department: in-scope=200, out-of-scope=403 and missing param=400 work on every endpoint. Mixed in-scope dept + out-of-scope faculty is rejected with 403. A non-ObjectId dept is rejected with 403. A user with no assignment or missing keys gets 403. Fake archive semester returns 400/403/404 as expected. Certificates/statements are limited to the faculty derived from the department, and statements?faculty_id=<foreign> returns 403. Regression: admin gets 200 on all endpoints (404 on the fake archive). Saeed's results match his legacy permissions: 200 for attendance/reports/enrollments/alumni/faculty-board, 403 for teaching-load/certificates/statements, and 403 for statements?faculty_id=<foreign>. No real-enforcement 400 message ever reached legacy users. Test users, roles, assignments and audit logs were deleted afterwards.

critical.issue: Scope leak for real-enforcement users. The guard only checks department_id. When teacher_id is set, teacher_query becomes {_id: teacher_id} and drops the department filter. A user scoped to dept 698e500997fef774e66e93a8 got the load of Saeed (dept 698e501d97fef774e66e93a9) in teacher_comparison and teachers_without_courses. courses_without_teacher also became university-wide: it returned courses from 4 departments, including other faculties.

Scope widening for a real-enforcement user with 2 department assignments in 2 different faculties. sync_real_enforcement_context derives faculty_ids=[F_A,F_B]. get_user_scope_filter then applies its multi-faculty rule (len(faculty_ids)>=2 means the WHOLE faculties), so _scope_department_ids covers every department of both faculties. The course_id branch skips the department_id filter, so a course from an UNASSIGNED sibling department (e.g. 'عقيدة' in faculty 698e4f92...) returned 200 with candidate data. The same widening affects every legacy scope-filter path for these users (students/courses/teachers lists).

minor.issue: A non-ObjectId id returns 500 (ObjectId() is called without validation). This existed before this change and affects admin too. It should return 400/404.

Design concern: a user scoped to one department gets the whole derived faculty (q.faculty_id in fids), so certificates/statements of sibling departments are visible. Today all 37 statements and 1 certificate in that faculty belong to dept A, so nothing actually leaked, but in principle the scope widens from department to faculty. Consider filtering by department_id when the assignment is department-scoped.

Saeed (dept head of 698e501d...) gets 200 on /reports/attendance-overview?department_id=<other dept>, /reports/department/<other dept> and /attendance/course/<other-dept course>. The legacy read paths have no department-ownership check. This is unchanged by this work; noted only for awareness.

action_items: teaching_load.advanced_teaching_load_report: for advanced_access_real_enforcement users, when teacher_id is set, check that the teacher belongs to the guarded department_id/faculty_id (else return 403 or empty). Also always scope courses_without_teacher to the guarded department/faculty.

sync_real_enforcement_context: the faculty_ids derived from department assignments must not trigger get_user_scope_filter's multi-faculty 'full faculties' rule. Store them in a separate field (e.g. adv_derived_faculty_ids) for certificates/statements, or only write faculty_ids for real faculty-scope assignments.
faculty_board.list_candidates: for real-enforcement users, when course_id is passed, verify that course.department_id matches the guarded department_id (or is inside the guarded faculty).
Optional: validate ObjectId in get_lecture_attendance / get_course_enrollments / get_course_detailed_report to avoid 500s.
Optional: restrict certificates/statements to department_id for department-scoped assignments.
critical_code_review_comments: real_enforce_guard checks only the department_id/faculty_id query param. Any other filter param that replaces the department filter downstream (teacher_id, course_id, student_id) needs its own ownership check. Audit all guarded endpoints for this pattern.

server.get_current_user does not call sync_real_enforcement_context, only routes/deps.get_current_user does. Legacy scope filters in server.py read department_ids from the DB, so they depend on the user having hit a routes/* endpoint first. The fail-safe blocks everything, so this is safe but can give empty results.
server.py is about 19.7k lines; the guard snippet (import + fetch entity + dep + guard) is duplicated about 10 times. Extract a helper such as guard_by_course(course_id, key) / guard_by_student(...).
test_credentials: admin/admin123, Saeed/test1234 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Temporary TEST_w2_* real-enforcement users were created by the suite and deleted.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. The suite creates TEST_w2_* users, roles and assignments through the API and deletes them from MongoDB in module teardown. No semester archiving was done.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python3 -m pytest tests/test_real_enforcement_wave2.py -q. Dept A=698e500997fef774e66e93a8 (faculty 698e4f92..., siblings 698f671331cfba92c49a550c and 698f8093539792f8917b7bd3 'عقيدة'). Dept B=698e501d97fef774e66e93a9 (faculty 698e4fb4...). The two expected-to-fail tests until fixed are test_escalation_advanced_report_foreign_teacher and test_multi_faculty_dept_assignments_no_widening. No archived semesters exist, so use fakesemester123 only.
rca of the issue: Leak 1: in routes/teaching_load.py around line 1197, `if teacher_id: teacher_query = {'_id': ObjectId(teacher_id)}` replaces the department filter after the guard has already approved department_id. Leak 2: in services/advanced_access_service.py sync_real_enforcement_context (lines 319-334), faculty_ids is derived from every assigned department. With 2+ faculties, server.get_user_scope_filter (lines 1131-1141) widens the scope to the full faculties. faculty_board.list_candidates' course_id branch then trusts only that widened scoped_dep_ids. To reproduce: create a real-enforcement user with department assignments A and B, call /api/alumni?department_id=A (triggers the sync), then /api/faculty-board/candidates?department_id=A&course_id=<course in a sibling dept of A>. Result: 200.
